name: Orbit AI - Phase 2 - Compliant hours + off-hours consent gate (W2.7, new - not in the brief's original numbering)

nodes.name: Compliant hours webhook
nodes.notes: Same 'hard action-layer block, called synchronously by the dialer before it ever dials' pattern as dnc-check.workflow.json (W2.6) - meant to run alongside that check, not instead of it. Input contract: {opportunityId, locationId, requestedAt?} - requestedAt is optional (defaults to now server-side), present so a scheduled/queued dial attempt can be checked against the time it will actually fire, not the time it was scheduled.

nodes.name: Fetch Location
nodes.notes: Needs Location's state field (new this pass - CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md) to know which calling-hours window applies. Same Twenty CRM REST-shape uncertainty as every workflow in this library.

nodes.name: Fetch ConsentRecords
nodes.notes: Only reached when the requested time is outside the compliant-hours window - ConsentRecord (new this pass, CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md) is the exception's evidence trail.
